methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series G → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.25x) to $75M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Earth AI, a Series G infrastructure and logistics company founded by Roman Teslyuk, has raised $20M to date. This valuation analysis is constrained by the absence of comparable public or private peers in the available dataset, limiting triangulation to a single methodology.

The stage-progression method applies a 1.25x step-up multiplier typical of Series G advancement to a $75M base value derived from total capital raised, yielding an implied valuation of $94M. This approach assumes that Earth AI's funding trajectory and dilution profile align with sector norms for this stage. The resulting range spans $80M (low) to $108M (high), with a median of $94M.

The primary uncertainty stems from methodology concentration: with only one applicable approach and no peer comparables, the analysis cannot validate whether Earth AI's capital efficiency or burn profile diverges materially from stage expectations. The $75M proxy itself—derived from disclosed raised capital—may understate or overstate fair value depending on deployment pace, unit economics, and market conditions in infrastructure and logistics. Additional diligence on revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and competitive positioning would be required to stress-test this range. The analysis supports a valuation band of $80M–$108M, centered at $94M, pending access to comparable transaction data or operational metrics.
